unitChecks.reason: 公收其八，二分入私 assigns eight-tenths public and two private; en eighty-twenty split with the state can reverse who takes eight.
公收其七，三分入私 needs explicit public seven / private three; bare seventy-thirty split leaves share owners unclear.
Remonstrance opening covers sage-king light taxes, storing among the people, three land grades, and one-tenth levy.
使家給人足 requires household provision and every person having enough; current en drops 人足.
Rhetorical why flood and drought are not disasters is covered in both fields.
高選農官 is careful selection of farm officers, not high-ranking officers; 勸課 and unaided hundred-mu tillage remain.
旌顯 means publicly commend and distinguish; it does not specify a physical banner. 不齒 is exclusion from standing among one’s peers.
裁而祿之 means determine remuneration in proportion to estimated annual income, not necessarily trim or cut salaries.
Beyond officials, store in the Great Granary; three years' tillage leaves one year's surplus—covered.
Accumulated thus, how could public use be insufficient—both fields match.
Flood and drought, what can they do to the people—exclamation covered.
志勤在公 and 銳盡地利 are both denied; current en collapses them and loses land advantage.
征殺 includes summoning-then-execution, and 以十數 means counted by tens, not simply more than ten.
Current en omits 千里無煙, 饑寒流隕, and successive falling into ditches.
Former king's might and virtue, frontier peoples' influx, tenfold displaced, four-in-ten landless covered.
繼武 means following a predecessor’s footsteps, not martial expansion; 闡廣 is expansion, and 有高西伯 says the achievements surpass those of the Earl of the West.
宜省罷諸苑 requires reduce-and-abolish to settle the displaced; current en only reduces.
Arrivals without property are granted herding cattle—both fields cover the grant.
If the people are Your Highness's, the cattle are not lost—rhetorical point intact.
Those who store well store among the people; that is all—covered.
邇者 may be recent-time or nearby people as subject of 副; current you-have-fulfilled reading is not uniquely proved.
削百姓不至於七八 means exactions did not reach seven or eight tenths; below-seven-or-eight misstates the share.
Still not a clear king's way, worse if increased—both fields match.
Yao-Tang flood-drought, Zheng-Bai and Ximen-Shi Qi irrigation, Yunhan and mire covered.
Forced relocation of Goguryeo, Baekje, Yuwen, Duan versus Chinese who came for righteousness—covered.
Current en drops deep-harm fear and not-scattering among settled people while learning state strength.
一夫不耕，歲受其饑 is yearlong hunger/privation from one non-plower, not the year itself hungering.
一人食一人之力 explicitly gives the one-to-one labor burden, 損亦如之 extends it to tens of thousands, and 家給人足 requires both household provision and personal sufficiency.
No governmental evil exceeds this after reading past and present—covered.
經略出世 is world-surpassing/outstanding strategy, not world-ranging; both fields understate 出世.
Beyond that, plow to eat and raise silkworms to clothe as heaven's way—covered.
人盡芻蕘 is exhausting rustic/woodcutter counsel, not literal firewood and grass; en also drops 聖性 and 有犯.
意在無責 may mean not assigning blame or aiming to be without culpability; current blame/offense gloss is unproven.
Current en omits memorial-to-law path, merciful acceptance, and 削黜禁錮，不齒於朝 detail.
If their words were right, accept them—both fields match.
If not, allow for blunt integrity—covered.
Current en drops 豈有得邪 after the north-to-Yue analogy.
Flattery, light impeachment of remonstrators, no backbone yet envy, covering eyes and ears—covered.
Four occupations sustain the state; teaching and learning are its great affair—covered.
War training and agriculture are especially the root—covered.
Craftsmen and merchants remain the branch—covered.
徒充大員 in this quota context is vainly filling the authorized establishment, not merely great posts.
If the servant's words are right, enact swiftly—covered.
登 adds immediacy to 加罪戮. The current literal includes execution but omits this explicit demand for prompt action.
Pardon scale-ruffling offense and gather medicine-stone counsel—covered.
Order opens: reading Secretary Feng's remonstrance truly makes the ruler afraid—covered.
君以黎元為國 takes the people as the state's basis, not that the ruler exists for the people.
En drops first-month orders, urging lazy farmers, and especially-unopened-wasteland penalty; literal misreads 尤 as blame.
Responsible officials examine carefully and submit full reports—covered.
Parks may all be abolished for commoners without fields or livelihood—sense present.
Current en states only the ox grant and omits 全無資產，不能自存 describing the recipients.
私有餘力 and 墾官田 are missing from the rent paraphrase.
主者 are responsible officials, not engineers; 務盡水陸之勢 is also lost in current en.
Unpacified heartland, ongoing war, many meritorious loyal men, bureaucracy cannot be cut—covered.
Wait until villains are crushed, then slowly deliberate again—covered.
四佐與列將 fix artisan-merchant quotas; current en caps the wrong parties and literal obscures the subject.
不任訓教 means unfit to receive instruction, not idle students or students who fail to teach.
Hard for ministers to speak; set aside baseless matters; choose and follow the good—covered.
罪應禁黜 means their offenses warrant ban and dismissal of the persons; literal makes crimes themselves banned.
Restore original offices and still serve in remonstrance posts—covered.
封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體 praises Master Feng's steadfast ministerial character; en over-thins and literal misreads 生/體.
Odes 無言不酬 with rhetorical 不云乎 preserved; quotation boundary before the grant holds.
Grant fifty thousand cash and announce open fault-stating without rank taboo—covered.
去龍二百餘步 is more than two hundred paces away, but anomalous 祭乙太宰 blocks a definite sacrifice reading.
Dragons crossed heads, sported and soared, shed horns, and left—covered.
Pleasure, return, pardon, Helong palace, Longxiang temple on the mountain—covered.
Current en invents reopened, drops old-palace location and official-student sons of ministers, thins monthly observation.
Love of texts, diligence in lecturing, students over a thousand—covered.
Taishang Chapter replacing Jijiu and fifteen Canonical Admonitions for noble sons—covered.
Murong Ke took Nansu, posted a garrison, returned—covered.
Third year: Jun and Ke with 17,000 cavalry east vs Puyu; king and over 50,000 captured—covered.
經通秀異者 are those thorough and outstanding in the classics, not merely the best students.
以久旱，丐百姓田租 remits commoners' field rent for prolonged drought; en thins and literal begged-off errs.
罷…等郡 does not call the commanderies empty; that adjective is unsupported.
Current en drops Xingji, Ningji, Xingping, Yuli, and Wu county mappings under Yan.

knownDecisions.before: The ruler exists for his people; the people live on grain.
knownDecisions.after: The ruler takes the people as the foundation of the state; the people depend on grain for their lives.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 君以黎元為國，黎元以穀為命。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 君以黎元為國 states the ruler’s dependence on the people as the state’s basis, not the different proposition that the ruler exists for the people.

knownDecisions.before: Cap tradesmen and aides to fixed quotas; everyone else goes back to the plow.
knownDecisions.after: The Four Assistants and the generals shall promptly fix quotas for artisans and merchants; the rest shall return to farming.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 百工商賈數，四佐與列將速定大員，余者還農。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 百工商賈數 is the matter to be regulated; 四佐與列將 are officials instructed to fix the quotas, not aides whose numbers are being capped.

knownDecisions.before: Hundred crafts and merchants’ numbers, four assistants and column generals quickly fix great quotas; the rest return to farming.
knownDecisions.after: As for the numbers of artisans and merchants, let the Four Assistants and the generals promptly establish the overall quotas; let the remainder return to farming.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 百工商賈數，四佐與列將速定大員，余者還農。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: The current literal field obscures the subject and imperative. 四佐與列將速定大員 assigns the quota-setting duty to the Four Assistants and generals.

knownDecisions.before: Strike idle students from the rolls.
knownDecisions.after: Students unable to benefit from instruction shall also be removed from the rolls.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 不任訓教 concerns inability to receive or bear instruction; the adjective idle substitutes a judgment of diligence not stated here.

knownDecisions.before: Students who do not bear training and teaching, also remove from rolls.
knownDecisions.after: Students who are not capable of receiving instruction shall also be removed from the rolls.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 不任訓教 does not mean students fail to bear the work of training and teaching others. The students are recipients of instruction.

knownDecisions.before: Feng Sheng staunchly upright, deeply attained the body of a royal minister.
knownDecisions.after: Master Feng is steadfastly upright and deeply embodies the character of a royal minister.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 封生 is an honorific designation of Feng, identified earlier in the complete linked passage as 封裕, not a personal name Feng Sheng. 王臣之體 concerns ministerial character, not a physical body.

knownDecisions.before: A black dragon and a white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang led his court within two hundred paces and offered the great sacrifice.
knownDecisions.after: At that time one black dragon and one white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led his officials to observe them from more than two hundred paces away and offered a sacrifice (source wording 祭乙太宰 remains uncertain and is not silently emended).
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 時有黑龍、白龍各一，見於龍山，皝親率群僚觀之，去龍二百餘步，祭乙太宰。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 去龍二百餘步 and 親率群僚觀之 are clear; 祭乙太宰 is anomalous in the supplied Chinese, so distance and observation are fixed while the sacrifice wording stays explicitly unresolved without emendation.

knownDecisions.before: At the time there were black dragon and white dragon each one, appeared at Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them, two hundred-odd steps from the dragons, sacrificed with the grand boar offering.
knownDecisions.after: At the time there were one black dragon and one white dragon, which appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them at a distance of more than two hundred paces from the dragons, and performed a sacrifice (anomalous source wording 祭乙太宰 left unresolved; not read as a grand-boar offering or silent 太牢 emendation).
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 時有黑龍、白龍各一，見於龍山，皝親率群僚觀之，去龍二百餘步，祭乙太宰。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: Literal must not render 祭乙太宰 as a grand boar or imported 太牢; correct the distance phrasing and leave the sacrifice wording unresolved.

knownDecisions.before: He labeled elite students “high-gate pupils,” reopened the eastern school for archery rites, and each month examined their progress.
knownDecisions.after: He gave the sons and younger brothers of his senior ministers who were official students the title “high-gate students,” established the eastern school in the old palace for the village archery rites, and personally observed and assessed their performance each month.
knownDecisions.sourceQuote: 賜其大臣子弟為官學生者號高門生，立東庠于舊宮，以行鄉射之禮，每月臨觀，考試優劣。
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 立東庠于舊宮 establishes a school in the old palace; it does not say reopened. The fuller wording also preserves the official-student qualification and the kinship group receiving the title.

knownDecisions.before: Because of long drought, begged off common people’s field rent.
knownDecisions.after: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people’s field tax.
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 丐百姓田租 here is remission of the commoners' field rent/tax; begged off misstates the ruler's act. Independently, current en also understates 久旱 and 百姓 and is repaired separately.

knownDecisions.before: He abolished several empty commanderies such as Chengzhou, Jiyang, and Yingqiu.
knownDecisions.after: He abolished Chengzhou, Jiyang, Yingqiu, and other commanderies.
knownDecisions.sourceReason: 罷成周、冀陽、營丘等郡 does not describe the commanderies as empty. Remove that unsupported characterization; the literal field already preserves the unqualified abolition.

additionalCorrections.before: Poor households received draft oxen to till the royal park on an eighty-twenty revenue split with the state.
additionalCorrections.after: Herding oxen were given to poor families to till fields in the royal park; the state took eight-tenths, and two-tenths went to the private holders.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 以牧牛給貧家，田于苑中，公收其八，二分入私。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 公收其八，二分入私 assigns eight-tenths to the public and two private; eighty-twenty with the state can reverse those shares.

additionalCorrections.before: Householders who owned cattle but no land tilled the park on a seventy-thirty split.
additionalCorrections.after: Those who had oxen but no land also tilled the park; the state took seven-tenths, and three-tenths went to the private holders.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 有牛而無地者，亦田苑中，公收其七，三分入私。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 公收其七，三分入私 must keep public seven-tenths and private three-tenths explicit rather than an ownerless seventy-thirty split.

additionalCorrections.before: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry until every household is provided for.
additionalCorrections.after: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 寒者衣之，饑者食之，使家給人足。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 家給人足 is paired household provision and personal sufficiency; omitting 人足 drops half the result.

additionalCorrections.before: Because high agricultural officers are chosen and encouragement enforced, each man tends a full hundred mu without borrowing oxen;
additionalCorrections.after: Agricultural officers are carefully selected and encouragement and assessment are pressed to the utmost, so each man tends a full hundred mu without borrowing oxen;
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 高選農官，務盡勸課，人治周田百畝，亦不假牛力；
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 高選 is careful selection of farm officers, not high-ranking officers; 勸課 includes assessment.

additionalCorrections.before: those who labor receive honors and the idle are punished.
additionalCorrections.after: those who labor in the fields receive honors of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being denied peer standing.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 旌顯之賞 and 不齒之罰 name distinctive honor and the unranked penalty, not bare honors-versus-punished.

additionalCorrections.before: Offices are matched to need, men do not hold empty posts, and salaries are trimmed to yearly revenue.
additionalCorrections.after: Again, assess the work to establish offices and the offices to appoint personnel, ensuring that offices meet needs and no one occupies a post in vain; estimate the annual revenue and set their salaries accordingly.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 量事置官，量官置人 are separate staffing steps. 裁而祿之 sets salaries according to estimated annual revenue; it does not necessarily order salary reductions.

additionalCorrections.before: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no magistrate or two-thousand-bushel official works the land with public zeal.
additionalCorrections.after: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no two-thousand-bushel official or magistrate is intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 雖務農之令屢發，二千石令長莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者 denies both public diligence and exhausting land advantage.

additionalCorrections.before: Knowing this, Han's founder executed more than ten such officials for false land reports, and under Ming and Zhang the age was nearly peaceful.
additionalCorrections.after: Knowing this, Han's founder summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and under Ming and Zhang the age was called nearly peaceful.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 故漢祖知其如此，以墾田不實，征殺二千石以十數，是以明、章之際，號次升平。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 征殺 keeps summon-and-execute; 以十數 is counted by tens; 墾田 and 號次升平 should not be thinned away.

additionalCorrections.before: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, executed more than ten such officials for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.
additionalCorrections.after: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 故漢祖知其如此，以墾田不實，征殺二千石以十數，是以明、章之際，號次升平。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: Literal likewise needs 征 as summon before execution and 以十數 as counted by tens, not more than ten.

additionalCorrections.before: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate and hunger fills the ditches.
additionalCorrections.after: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; hunger and cold bring ruin, and people fall one after another into the ditches.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 自永嘉喪亂，百姓流亡，中原蕭條，千里無煙，饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 千里無煙, 饑寒流隕, and 相繼溝壑 are distinct desolation propositions omitted by the abbreviated en.

additionalCorrections.before: Your Highness, with heroic endowment, has extended the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li and added a hundred thousand households, rivaling the great Earl of the West.
additionalCorrections.after: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 繼武 means following a predecessor’s footsteps, not martial expansion; 闡廣 is expansion, and 有高西伯 says the achievements surpass those of the Earl of the West.

additionalCorrections.before: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, continuing the merit of martial expansion, rivaling the great Earl of the West.
additionalCorrections.after: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 繼武 means following a predecessor’s footsteps, not martial expansion; 闡廣 is expansion, and 有高西伯 says the achievements surpass those of the Earl of the West.

additionalCorrections.before: Reduce the royal parks and settle refugees on the land.
additionalCorrections.after: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and settle the displaced on them.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 宜省罷諸苑，以業流人。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 宜省罷諸苑 requires both reduction and abolition to give livelihood to the displaced.

additionalCorrections.before: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; official-ox farmers gave six parts to the state and four to the people, private-ox farmers split evenly, and all rejoiced.
additionalCorrections.after: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, still did not cut the people by as much as seven or eight tenths; those farming with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people, those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state, and the people were secure and all rejoiced.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 且魏、晉雖道消之世，猶削百姓不至於七八，持官牛田者官得六分，百姓得四分，私牛而官田者與官中分，百姓安之，人皆悅樂。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 削百姓不至於七八 caps exaction short of 7–8/10, matching later 6/4 and 5/5; below-seven-or-eight misreads the share.

additionalCorrections.before: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.
additionalCorrections.after: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not cut into the people as far as seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 且魏、晉雖道消之世，猶削百姓不至於七八，持官牛田者官得六分，百姓得四分，私牛而官田者與官中分，百姓安之，人皆悅樂。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: Same 七八 share correction as en: exaction stops short of seven or eight tenths.

additionalCorrections.before: With households nearing a hundred thousand crowded against the capital, divide their kindred and move them to western border cities, ruling them with kindness and law so they do not learn the state's strength and weakness.
additionalCorrections.after: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state. Divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and restrain them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 今戶垂十萬，狹湊都城，恐方將為國家深害，宜分其兄弟宗屬，徙于西境諸城，撫之以恩，檢之以法，使不得散在居人，知國之虛實。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 恐方將為國家深害 and 使不得散在居人，知國之虛實 are omitted or conflated in the abbreviated en.

additionalCorrections.before: The central plain is not pacified and stores must grow, yet offices multiply and idlers abound; one man who does not plow makes the year hungrier.
additionalCorrections.after: The central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; when one man does not plow, hunger is suffered through the year.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 今中原未平，資畜宜廣，官司猥多，遊食不少，一夫不耕，歲受其饑。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 歲受其饑 is yearlong hunger/privation consequent on one non-plower, not the year itself made hungrier.

additionalCorrections.before: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; one man who does not plow, the year receives his hunger.
additionalCorrections.after: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; when one man does not plow, hunger is suffered through the year.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 今中原未平，資畜宜廣，官司猥多，遊食不少，一夫不耕，歲受其饑。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: Literal year-receives-his-hunger personifies 歲; render the yearlong privation caused by one non-plower.

additionalCorrections.before: Food taken from plowmen feeds idlers; tens of thousands eat without plowing, and the loss is the same; how can every household be provided for and the realm governed to peace!
additionalCorrections.after: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed them; one person consumes the labor of one person, and with tens of thousands living without working, the loss is likewise in the tens of thousands; how can every household be provided for and every person have enough, and government bring about peace!
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 一人食一人之力 explicitly gives the one-to-one labor burden, 損亦如之 extends it to tens of thousands, and 家給人足 requires both household provision and personal sufficiency.

additionalCorrections.before: Men of world-ranging talent may be placed as needed.
additionalCorrections.after: Those with world-surpassing strategy and talent matching the age's needs may be placed in posts as required.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 其有經略出世，才稱時求者，自可隨須置之列位。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 經略出世 is world-surpassing/outstanding strategy, not world-ranging talent alone.

additionalCorrections.before: Those with world-ranging strategy and talent suited to the age's needs may be placed in posts as needed.
additionalCorrections.after: Those with world-surpassing strategy and talent matching the age's needs may be placed in posts as needed.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 其有經略出世，才稱時求者，自可隨須置之列位。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: Literal world-ranging understates 出世; use world-surpassing strategy with talent matching the times.

additionalCorrections.before: Your Highness is broad and clear, thirsting for counsel; men speak even humble truths without hiding.
additionalCorrections.after: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for counsel as for water; therefore men fully offer even rustic woodcutter counsel, offending yet not hiding.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 殿下聖性寬明，思言若渴，故人盡芻蕘，有犯無隱。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 聖性, 芻蕘 as rustic counsel, and 有犯無隱 must remain; humble truths without hiding understates them.

additionalCorrections.before: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men exhaust even firewood and grass, offending yet not hiding.
additionalCorrections.after: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men fully offer even the counsel of woodcutters and fuel-gatherers, offending yet not hiding.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 殿下聖性寬明，思言若渴，故人盡芻蕘，有犯無隱。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 人盡芻蕘 is the idiom of exhausting humble rustic counsel, not exhausting firewood and grass as materials.

additionalCorrections.before: Officials charged them with demonic speech; Your Highness pardoned their capital crime yet still barred them from court.
additionalCorrections.after: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 主者奏以妖言犯上，至之于法，殿下慈弘苞納，恕其大辟，猶削黜禁錮，不齒於朝。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 主者奏…至之于法, 慈弘苞納, and 削黜禁錮，不齒於朝 are under-covered by the shortened current en.

additionalCorrections.before: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue!
additionalCorrections.after: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be any gain!
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 罪諫臣而求直言，亦猶北行詣越，豈有得邪！
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 豈有得邪 completes the analogy and must not be dropped.

additionalCorrections.before: Measure army and state needs, set posts, return the rest to farming, teach battle methods, and send students who fail after three years back to the fields; do not fill posts vainly and block worthy men.
additionalCorrections.after: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill the authorized establishment and block the path of the keen and worthy.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 宜量軍國所須，置其員數，已外歸之于農，教之戰法，學者三年無成，亦宜還之于農，不可徒充大員，以塞聰俊之路。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 大員 here continues the quota/establishment sense, not an unspecified fill posts; keep the full sequential commands.

additionalCorrections.before: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill great posts and block the path of the keen and worthy.
additionalCorrections.after: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill the authorized establishment and block the path of the keen and worthy.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 宜量軍國所須，置其員數，已外歸之于農，教之戰法，學者三年無成，亦宜還之于農，不可徒充大員，以塞聰俊之路。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 徒充大員 is vainly filling the authorized establishment/quotas, not great posts.

additionalCorrections.before: if not, punish me, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
additionalCorrections.after: if not, punish and execute me at once, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 登加罪戮 calls for immediate punishment and execution of the speaker, not merely unspecified punishment.

additionalCorrections.before: Agriculture is the foundation, yet magistrates ignore spring plowing—those who leave fields idle should face punishment to wake the commanderies.
additionalCorrections.after: Agriculture is then the root of the state, yet two-thousand-bushel officials and county magistrates do not obey the first-month orders and do not urge lazy farmers; those especially who fail to open wasteland should be put under criminal law to awe and discipline the dependent cities.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 然則農者，國之本也，而二千石令長不遵孟春之令，惰農弗勸，宜以尤不修辟者措之刑法，肅厲屬城。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 孟春之令, 惰農弗勸, 尤不修辟者, and 肅厲屬城 are missing from the compressed en.

additionalCorrections.before: Then farming is the state’s root, yet two-thousand-bushel magistrates and county chiefs do not obey the first month’s orders, lazy farmers are not urged—ought with blame on those who do not cultivate wasteland apply to them criminal law, to awe and encourage dependent cities.
additionalCorrections.after: Then farming is the state's root, yet two-thousand-bushel magistrates and county chiefs do not obey the first-month orders, and lazy farmers are not urged; those especially who do not open wasteland should be put under criminal law, to awe and discipline the dependent cities.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 然則農者，國之本也，而二千石令長不遵孟春之令，惰農弗勸，宜以尤不修辟者措之刑法，肅厲屬城。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 尤不修辟者 means especially those who fail to open wasteland; with blame on those misreads 尤.

additionalCorrections.before: Give each destitute household a draft ox.
additionalCorrections.after: The poor who wholly lack assets and cannot support themselves shall each be granted one ox.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 貧者全無資產，不能自存，各賜牧牛一頭。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 全無資產，不能自存 identifies the recipients; the bare grant leaves that description out without forcing a draft/herding label.

additionalCorrections.before: Whoever wishes to rent state oxen and state land may do so under Wei–Jin precedent.
additionalCorrections.after: If any have surplus private labor and gladly take official oxen to reclaim official fields, let them follow the old Wei and Jin rules.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 若私有餘力，樂取官牛墾官田者，其依魏、晉舊法。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 私有餘力 and 墾官田 specify surplus labor reclaiming official fields under Wei-Jin rules.

additionalCorrections.before: Dig irrigation works for public and private good—let engineers plan every channel.
additionalCorrections.after: Irrigation ditches and channels benefit public and private interests; let the responsible officials plan and build them, striving to exhaust the advantages of water and land.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 溝洫溉灌，有益官私，主者量造，務盡水陸之勢。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 主者 are responsible officials, not engineers, and 務盡水陸之勢 remains the construction aim.

additionalCorrections.before: Wang Xian and Liu Ming although their crimes ought to be banned and dismissed, also is my lacking great measure.
additionalCorrections.after: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, although their offenses warrant ban and dismissal, also show my own lack of great forbearance.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 王憲、劉明雖其罪應禁黜，亦猶孤之無大量也。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 罪應禁黜 warrants ban and dismissal of the persons; saying crimes ought to be banned and dismissed misassigns the object.

additionalCorrections.before: Feng Yu spoke as a true minister should.
additionalCorrections.after: Master Feng is steadfastly upright and deeply embodies the character of a royal minister.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體 praises steadfast ministerial character; the thin current en drops both clauses.

additionalCorrections.before: He tested students at the eastern school and promoted the best as attendants.
additionalCorrections.after: Huang personally went to the eastern school to examine students; those whose command of the classics was thorough and outstanding were promoted to fill posts as close attendants.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 經通秀異者 is the classical-proficiency criterion for promotion, not a bare the best.

additionalCorrections.before: He remitted rent during a drought.
additionalCorrections.after: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people's field rent.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 以久旱，丐百姓田租。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: Independent of the literal proposal, 久旱 and 百姓田租 require prolonged drought and commoners' field rent in en.

additionalCorrections.before: He grouped refugees from Bohai, Hejian, Guangping, Wei, Donglai, Beihai, and Wu into new counties under Yan.
additionalCorrections.after: He made the Bohai people into Xingji County, the Hejian people into Ningji County, the Guangping and Wei commandery people into Xingping County, the Donglai and Beihai people into Yuli County, and the Wu people into Wu County, all subordinate to the state of Yan.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 以勃海人為興集縣，河間人為寧集縣，廣平、魏郡人為興平縣，東萊、北海人為育黎縣，吳人為吳縣，悉隸燕國。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: Each settler group and its new county under Yan must be named; unnamed new counties omit those mappings.

additionalCorrections.before: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate yearly revenue and trim salaries accordingly.
additionalCorrections.after: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate the amount of annual revenue and determine their salaries accordingly.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 裁而祿之 means determine remuneration in proportion to estimated annual income, not necessarily trim or cut salaries.

additionalCorrections.before: Those who labor in the fields receive banners of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being unranked.
additionalCorrections.after: Those who labor in the fields receive rewards of public commendation and distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of exclusion from standing among their peers.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 旌顯 means publicly commend and distinguish; it does not specify a physical banner. 不齒 is exclusion from standing among one’s peers.

additionalCorrections.before: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed others; one man eating the strength of one man, with tens of thousands idling, the loss is likewise; how can one achieve provision for every household and govern to peaceful ascendancy!
additionalCorrections.after: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed them; one person consumes the labor of one person, and with tens of thousands living without working, the loss is likewise in the tens of thousands; how can every household be provided for and every person have enough, and government bring about peace!
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 一人食一人之力 explicitly gives the one-to-one labor burden, 損亦如之 extends it to tens of thousands, and 家給人足 requires both household provision and personal sufficiency.

additionalCorrections.before: If not, add punishment and execution, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
additionalCorrections.after: If not, impose punishment and execution on me at once, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 登 adds immediacy to 加罪戮. The current literal includes execution but omits this explicit demand for prompt action.

sourceIssues.reason: Supplied Chinese ends with anomalous 祭乙太宰; from this packet alone the sacrifice wording cannot be fixed, so it is left unresolved without silent emendation.
Sacrifice clause cannot be given a definite English rite while 祭乙太宰 stands; distance and observation are repaired, offering left uncertain.
Literal sacrifice rendering is blocked by anomalous 祭乙太宰; grand-boar and silent 太牢 readings are rejected without resolving the wording.
邇者 may be temporal recently or nearby people as subject of 副; current you-have-fulfilled reading is one unprovable choice, so no emendation.
Same 邇者/副 uncertainty as en; literal likewise uses recently you have fulfilled without proving that subject.
意在無責 is unsettled between not assigning blame and aiming to be without culpability; meant no offense is not proved.
Literal intent was not to blame chooses one reading of 意在無責; left uncertain without a conjectural replacement.
